To organize a viewing or to place a bid on this property go to www.teamlorraine.ie or scan the QR code on the photograph section of this brochure.


 Circle of Legends` & Award-Winning International RE/MAX Agent for over 23 years, Team Lorraine Mulligan of RE/MAX Results welcomes you to 9 Griffeen Glen Crescent, Lucan, Co. Dublin. This is a super home with lots of potential located in a highly sought after location. This spacious, 3-bedroom semi-detached home is suitable first time buyers or a growing family, with a large rear garden which gives the opportunity to extend in the future. This residence also enjoys vacant possession so the new owners can move in with ease, peace and comfort once the sale closes. 

As you step inside, you`ll be greeted by a bright and inviting hallway. The sitting room is to the front of this property and enjoys a traditional style and welcoming homely open fireplace for those long cozy evenings. The kitchen/dining area over looks the private back garden which has the added advantage of being south facing. There is also a Guest WC.

The upstairs accommodation consists of three well-appointed bedrooms with the primary being ensuite. There is also a family sized bathroom.

No. 9 enjoys a delightful front and back garden, and this home enjoys off street parking. This property is also located close to a delightful green area.

Conveniently located in Lucan, this property offers easy access to local amenities, schools, parks, and transportation options like the M4 and M50 motorways, ensuring a convenient and comfortable lifestyle. 

Griffeen Glen, nestled in the vibrant suburb of Lucan, Co. Dublin, offers residents a harmonious blend of modern conveniences and a great location. This well-established community is renowned for its family-friendly atmosphere, excellent amenities, and proximity to Dublin city centre. Griffeen Glen is also close to plenty of local and recreational amenities as well as superb schools. 

Griffeen Glen`s strategic location ensures excellent connectivity. The area is well-served by public transport, with numerous bus routes providing swift access to Dublin city centre. Additionally, there is proximity to major road networks, such as the N4 and M50. The train station at Adamstown with parking facilities is only 6 minutes` drive away.

Finally, Griffeen Glen in Lucan combines the tranquillity of suburban living with the convenience of urban amenities. Its rich array of facilities, green spaces, and community-focused environment make it an ideal place for families and individuals seeking a balanced lifestyle. 

Don`t miss the opportunity to make this charming property your new home sweet home.
